purpose: Teach: 客席/エンディング/上回っ/見逃し/ミネラル/延々と/深める/と同時に

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、運動会で、絶対、客席、絶対、お父さんが、絶対、応援、絶対、してくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad really did cheer for me at sports day. He was so serious about it.
lines.style: Bright, earnest rush of words. Eager to share something that mattered. Quick pace, animated — looking for validation that the memory is as big as it feels.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、映画の、絶対、エンディング、絶対、泣いてたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad cried at the end of that movie, Sho. Seriously.
lines.style: Warm, gentle observation. A small smile in the voice — she's thinking of him. Slow, knowing pace. The tone of someone remembering something tender.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、点数、絶対、目標を、絶対、上回った、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mom, my test score actually beat my target. I really did it.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Still eager to share but grounded now — stating a fact he's proud of. Even pace, steady confidence. Not bragging; just pleased with himself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、勉強の、絶対、大事なところを、絶対、見逃した、絶対、ら、絶対、ダメよ
lines.en: Sho, the important thing about studying is not to miss the real lessons. You understand that, don't you?
lines.style: Gentle but firm. A mother's redirect — not sharp, but clear. Warm underneath; she's guiding, not scolding. Steady, measured pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ミネラル、絶対、ウォーター、絶対、飲みたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really want to drink some mineral water.
lines.style: Small, sudden desire breaking through. Innocent and direct — the way kids voice wants without self-consciousness. Quick, light tone. Not whining; just asking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、延々と、絶対、テレビ、絶対、見ちゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you can't spend all evening glued to the TV. Not today.
lines.style: Clear boundary set with warmth underneath. A mother who means it. Firm but not harsh. Slight edge of amusement at the transparency of his avoidance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お勉強で、絶対、知識を、絶対、深める、絶対、ようにするよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to study hard and really deepen my knowledge from now on.
lines.style: Sincere commitment. He means it in this moment. Earnest, steady voice without over-performance. Growing maturity in his tone — less performing for approval, more actual resolve.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: と同時に、翔くん、本気で、絶対、宿題、絶対、と、絶対、同時に、絶対、お手伝いも、絶対、お願いね
lines.en: And at the same time, Sho, I need you to help out around the house along with your homework, okay?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact kindness. She's asking, not demanding. Warm but clear about expectations. Slight rise at the end — checking for his agreement, trusting he'll come through.
